name: @pipeworx/mcp-spaceflight-news

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search spaceflight news articles aggregated from dozens of sources (Spaceflight Now, NASASpaceflight, NASA, SpaceX, Blue Origin, ESA, and more). Filter by source, publish date, and featured status. Newest first. Keyless.

search.description: Full-text query, e.g. "starship", "artemis", "mars sample return". Optional — omit to list recent articles.

news_site.description: Filter to a single source name, e.g. "Spaceflight Now", "NASASpaceflight". Use list_sources to discover names.

published_after.description: Only articles published on/after this ISO date or datetime, e.g. "2026-01-01" or "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".

featured_only.description: If true, return only editorially featured articles.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get a single spaceflight news article by its numeric id, with the full untruncated summary plus any associated launches and events. Keyless.

tools.name: latest_reports
tools.description: Latest long-form spaceflight mission reports (longer than standard news articles), newest first. Keyless.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List every news source the Spaceflight News API aggregates, plus the API version. Use the names to filter search_articles by news_site. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-spaceflight-news forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the spaceflight-news pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
